artifacts.summary: 13-phase plan applying one written house style sheet across all 17 Typst manual chapters: style sheet first, shared template centralization second, ten parallel-safe per-chapter conformance phases ordered by BLOCKING-finding load, then a whole-manual acceptance sweep.

memory_candidates.content: When a multi-file document (Typst manual, multi-module docs tree) fails a per-file quality gate with a large blocking count, decompose the plan by first root-causing the findings by rule rather than by file: a single convention gap often accounts for the overwhelming majority (here 288 of 296 findings were one citation-format rule). The resulting shape is: one phase writing the convention down as a committed style sheet, one additive phase centralizing shared helpers/macros the later phases depend on, then a wide parallel wave of per-file conformance phases ordered by that file's finding count, then one whole-document acceptance sweep. The per-file wave is genuinely parallel only if the centralization phase is additive (new definitions shadowed by still-present local ones), so no per-file phase needs to edit the shared template.
